title: Campus expansion: Lakeside College & Crestview State
text:
Author: **Maya Chen** · Status: Planning
## Why these two campuses
- **Lakeside College:** about 9,000 students, many commuters who struggle to find study partners. Launch in **January**, at the start of the spring semester.
- **Crestview State:** about 22,000 students, large intro courses with 300+ students per section. Launch in **March**, before midterms.
## What we learned from Westbrook
- A campus ambassador makes the biggest difference. Tomas Rivera brought in 40 students before launch.
- Launch right before midterms, when students are most motivated to study in groups
- Students want library room booking. Ask each campus library early.
## Plan for each campus
1. Recruit one campus ambassador (Tomas is helping find candidates)
2. Load the course catalog into pairly-api
3. Add the campus to the beta sign-up form on pairly-website
4. Run a 2-week private beta with 30-50 students
5. Public launch
## Open questions
- Do we need a paid ambassador role, or is it a volunteer role with perks?
- Can the matching service handle 22,000 students at Crestview State?
